resources.string: A calmer way to communicate in Korean and Bangla.

This build does not request microphone access or capture audio. Type or paste a phrase in the translator instead; no transcript is simulated.

Use the text translator for an on-device translation.
Use the text translator for an on-device translation.
AI reply generation is not connected. No suggested replies are being invented in this build.
Type or paste a phrase. Translation uses on-device language models after you approve their download.
Type or paste a phrase. After an approved model download, translation runs on this device; your text is not uploaded.
Situation category for a saved phrase

Download the Korean and Bengali language models over Wi-Fi to enable on-device translation. Typed text is not sent during model download.
Checking for language models stored on this device…
Download the Korean and Bengali models over Wi-Fi. This download starts only after you confirm. Translation text is processed on-device, not uploaded.
Downloading language models over Wi-Fi. Keep the app open and retry if the connection drops.
Models are installed. Translation runs locally on this device.
Could not check model availability. Check Google Play services and retry.
Model download failed. Connect to Wi-Fi, check Google Play services and try again. Your typed text was not sent.
Translation failed on this device. Check that the correct source language is selected and try again.
Machine translation can miss context, tone, or nuance. Confirm important medical, legal, financial, or safety information with a qualified person.
Could not save this phrase to local storage. Please try again.

Korean and Bengali model files will be downloaded over Wi-Fi using Google ML Kit / Google Play services and stored on this device. File size and storage use can vary. No typed phrase or audio is sent for translation. Continue only if you agree to the model download.
Review your saved phrases in Korean-to-Bangla or Bangla-to-Korean order.
This preview offers self-check flashcards from phrases you save. It does not score or claim learning progress.
Save a phrase to start a quiz
Practice uses only phrases you have explicitly saved. Browse the offline phrasebook and bookmark a few to begin.
Self-check only. Answers and progress are not recorded.
Browse offline starter phrases or save translations for quick access.
Use a bookmark to save a phrase from the offline phrasebook or save a translation from the text translator. Saved phrases stay on this device.
The bundled starter phrases are being added to the local database.
Could not initialize the offline phrasebook
The app could not add its bundled starter phrases to local storage. Nothing was sent anywhere. Please retry.

A clear view of what this build can—and cannot—do.
No microphone permission is declared or requested. Speech capture is not implemented.
No speech recognizer is connected. No audio is recorded or sent.
On-device ML Kit translation is available after you explicitly download language models over Wi-Fi. Translation output may be inaccurate.
No AI reply backend is configured. Conversation text is not sent to a generative service.
System text-to-speech is not connected in this increment.
Room stores the bundled phrasebook and saved phrases locally. Translation history is opt-in and can be deleted below.
History is off by default. When enabled, source and translated text are stored locally in Room, never uploaded by this feature. Existing entries stay until you clear them.
Showing five of the %1$d most recent history items loaded here.
Could not update that saved phrase. Please try again.
The translation succeeded, but its history entry could not be saved.
Could not delete translation history. Please try again.
This permanently deletes locally stored translation history. Saved phrases are not affected.

No audio is recorded. Translation text is processed on-device only after model installation. Model files are downloaded over Wi-Fi only after confirmation. Translation history is off by default; saved phrases and the offline phrasebook remain on this device.

Bundled starter phrases work without a network connection. Typed translation works offline only after the required ML Kit models are downloaded. Offline behavior has not yet been tested across devices; model availability can vary.
